testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and closes an empty browser search while editing a sketch ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited ✔ And the model browser is visible with its search field closed ✔ When the user selects the browser search control ✔ Then an empty search field appears beneath the browser header ✔ And the model browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible ✔ When the user selects the close control on the empty search field ✔ Then the search field is hidden ✔ And the browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible
